review_notes: I read all 109 lines of TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/ContinuousFamily.lean and checked its declarations against the supplied Mathlib commit. The file introduces no new structure, definition, notation, or representation: its five declarations are all theorem-level wrappers/specialisations. Specifically, `Continuous.isLocallyConstant_index` (lines 55-61) is a family-level corollary of Mathlib's `ContinuousLinearMap.index_continuousOn_isFredholm` (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Fredholm/Open.lean lines 102-106) together with `IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous` (Mathlib/Topology/LocallyConstant/Basic.lean lines 107-109). `ContinuousOn.index_eq_of_isPreconnected` (lines 65-71) and `Continuous.index_eq_of_preconnectedSpace` (lines 75-79) are index-specific specialisations of Mathlib's generic `IsPreconnected.constant` and `PreconnectedSpace.constant` in Mathlib/Topology/Connected/TotallyDisconnected.lean lines 327-337 and of the locally-constant API `IsLocallyConstant.apply_eq_of_isPreconnected` / `apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace` in Mathlib/Topology/LocallyConstant/Basic.lean lines 136-148. `Path.index_eq` (lines 82-86) and `index_eq_of_segment` (lines 97-103) are further named specialisations using Mathlib's `Path` preconnectedness and `Path.segment` (Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/PathConnected.lean lines 36-43). Under this rubric, these are useful named specialisations/wrappers, and the exclusions for standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening apply. I found no concrete incompatibility, duplicated substantive API, or repeated conversion attributable to a declaration in this file. One adjacent point, not reported as a finding because it is outside this file's declarations, is that `ContinuousLinearMap.index` itself is defined in the imported TauCeti.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Index file; that separate API was not reviewed as a target. Uncertainty remains only because I could not execute Lean or test alternative proofs; the judgement is based on source inspection.
